purpose: Manage mappings, aliases, code lists and controlled reference datasets as versioned reusable assets.
rules: Reference data has a stable ID, owner and released version.
Procedures pin the exact version used for reproducible runs.
Keys and expected cardinality are part of the dataset contract.
Effective dates and overlapping validity are validated when used.
Unmatched and ambiguous behavior is explicit.
Reference changes use dependency impact analysis before release.
Temporary exceptions have expiry or review policy instead of becoming permanent folklore.

starter_assets.purpose: Resolve known external customer names or IDs to governed business partner IDs.
Map plant/location identifiers across declared source systems.
Translate external supplier statuses into approved internal status values.
Control accepted material types for a migration validation procedure.
